import mir_eval

# Ensure lengths match between times and frequencies
n_ref = min(len(times), len(ref_freqs))

if n_ref > 1 and not np.all(np.diff(ref_t) > 0):

    est_t = np.arange(n_est, dtype=float)

# Convert raw time and frequency arrays into aligned cent and voicing arrays

)

accuracy = mir_eval.melody.overall_accuracy(ref_v, ref_c, est_v, est_c)

)
